page.title: Add-on modules
page.subtitle: Switch on only what you use. Switching off keeps your data and only hides the module's screens.
page.mayNotManage: Only the owner or an admin of the workspace can switch modules on or off

confirmOff.title: Switch off {module}?
confirmOff.content: The module's menus and buttons disappear for everyone in this workspace. Your data stays, and comes back whenever you switch it on again.

activeSubcontracts.title: {count, plural, one {# contract is still running} other {# contracts are still running}}
activeSubcontracts.content: If you switch it off now, your team will not see the subcontracting menu and crews can only view their contracts (no claims or edits) until you switch it on again. Nothing is lost.

cascade.title: Switch off {module}?
cascade.dependents: These modules depend on {module} and will be switched off too
cascade.work: Work still in progress (nothing is deleted, but it is out of reach until you switch it on again)

gate.title: {module} is switched off
gate.subTitle: This workspace is used for BOQ estimation only
gate.notEntitled: This workspace is not entitled to this module yet
gate.missingDependencies: Switch on the required modules first: {modules}

subcontracting.label: Subcontracting (find subcontractors)
subcontracting.hint: Send work from the BOQ to crews for quotes, compare prices, sign contracts and track payment installments

ai-assist.label: AI assistant (BOQ review, item matching)
ai-assist.hint: A decision model helps review the BOQ before sending and matches typed items to the catalogue; it never calculates numbers

workforce.label: Crews and staffing
workforce.hint: The company's crews and people, scheduling crews to planned work, and a cross-project staffing board with crew move suggestions

project-hub.label: Project hub
project-hub.hint: Every project at a glance: budget, documents and tasks in one place

portal.label: Role-based home
portal.hint: A home page showing what each person has to do for their role

boq-control.label: BOQ history and baseline
boq-control.hint: Keep BOQ history, compare versions and lock a baseline as the project budget

quotations.label: Quotations
quotations.hint: Bilingual quotations built from the BOQ, with version comparison, ready to send to customers

contracts.label: Main contracts and milestones
contracts.hint: Main contracts with owners, milestones, advance payments, retention and contract guarantees

billing.label: Billing and receipts
billing.hint: Progress claims, invoices, tax invoices, receipts and receivables tracking

variations.label: Variation orders
variations.hint: Variation orders that adjust the project budget when approved

procurement.label: Procurement
procurement.hint: Purchase requests, supplier quotations, purchase orders, goods receipts and 3-way matching

site-diary.label: Daily site reports
site-diary.hint: Daily site reports with photos, weather and headcount

labour.label: Daily labour
labour.hint: Timesheets, daily wages, 15-day pay periods and wage advances

job-cost.label: Job costing
job-cost.hint: Actual cost against budget, project profit and over-budget alerts

payables.label: Payables and payments
payables.hint: Supplier bills, payment runs and withholding tax certificates

handover.label: Handover and warranty
handover.hint: Handover, as-built drawings, warranty and project closeout
